gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-besley: Besley carries the page with the slight heft shifts of a stone-carved inscription, dignified and unhurried. Besley's strongest quality is that quiet carved authority, which Cherry Swash meets with its wide horseshoe c and uniform strokes.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-biz-udpmincho: Bent-wire curves meet a traditional hand. Cherry Swash is best at bold, distinctive lettering with a texture like neatly bent pipe cleaner, while BIZ UDPMincho is best at mild, mid-contrast strokes whose gaps keep letters from crowding.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bona-nova: Round, bold, and bookish all at once. Cherry Swash does best with its horseshoe c and bowls drawn at stem thickness, whereas Bona Nova does best with modest stress in curves that hold their mouths open.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bona-nova-sc: Cherry Swash opens with a horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, like following a single thread. Bona Nova SC follows with gentle stroke modulation and small counters that never feel clogged, so a size step down for it feels natural.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-brawler: Laser-etched lines, then literary softness. Cherry Swash traces every curve at constant width with a horseshoe c, and Brawler lets its stroke thickness shift gently, so the two feel like a machine drawing beside a pen.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-brygada-1918: Stems and arches of identical thickness, all through. Brygada 1918 brings subtle thick and thin modulation like a worn felt marker, so a long stretch of text feels traditional and dignified under that steady heading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-cactus-classical-: Wide-open and confident, with a horseshoe c up top. Cactus Classical Serif settles into a long read with an e opened wide and bowls that shift weight gently, authoritative without ever feeling heavy.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-caudex: Wide horseshoe curves, undimmed at every shoulder. Caudex is best at dignified text, with gaping e mouths and thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick, while Cherry Swash is best at commanding display lines.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Chiron Sung HK reads with a light modulation you notice mainly up close, and wide-set curve ends in its round forms. Cherry Swash overhead keeps one unchanging pen pressure, so a long page feels quietly authoritative.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-cinzel: Cinzel arrives loosely tracked, with a modest weight gap between stems and hairlines. Cinzel gives a long passage plenty of space, while Cherry Swash above it keeps joins as slim as a pipe cleaner.
